description: Shared native and TypeScript layer under RevenueDot's React Native, Flutter, Capacitor, Unity and Cordova SDKs, forked from RevenueCat's MIT purchases-hybrid-common.
rules: Do not install this package directly: install the RevenueDot React Native, Flutter, Capacitor, Unity or Cordova SDK, which pull it in.
Configure the wrapper SDK, not this layer: its `setProxyURL` and `configure` calls pass through to RevenueDot's native iOS and Android SDKs.
It publishes CocoaPods RevenueDotPurchasesHybridCommon and RevenueDotPurchasesHybridCommonUI, and Maven Central app.revenuedot.purchases:purchases-hybrid-common.

The npm packages are @revenuedot/purchases-typescript-internal, @revenuedot/purchases-typescript-internal-esm and @revenuedot/purchases-js-hybrid-mappings, installed through npm aliases by the wrappers.
RevenueDot Cloud (https://api.revenuedot.app) is the default API host; a self-hosted server is set with the wrapper SDK's `setProxyURL`.
